361 / 363 / 364: Cortech Summit All Purpose Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-361-363-364-summit-all-purpose-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/summit-table/
Spec sheets: 361 / 363 / 364, Concealed mounting
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Summit All Purpose Table – 361 / 363 / 364
Current H1: Cortech Summit All-Purpose Table - Molded Base with Laminate Top - Models 361, 363 & 364
Subtitle: Dining Height Table with a Molded Base and a 42” Round or Delta Laminate Top
Current subtitle: Cortech 361 363 364 All Purpose table with Delta Top or 42" Round Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Summit All Purpose Table is a dining height table with a molded base and a laminate top, for dining areas, dayrooms, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings. It comes with a 42” round top or a medium or large delta top.
The one-piece molded base has no exposed seams and attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The base can be filled with sandbags, and the table can also be bolted to the floor with optional concealed mounting.
Base: One-piece rotationally molded high impact polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Top: High-pressure laminate top with a Dura-Edge, in Gray Nebula with a black edge; it resists moisture and impact and cleans easily
Sizes: 42” round top (361), medium delta top (363), or large delta top (364)
Dimensions: 42”W×42”D×29”H (42” round top) or 44”W×43”D×29”H (delta top)
Weight: Base 16 lbs; delta top 45 lbs; 42” round top 56 lbs
Game Top: Optional game top for the 42” round table (361GT)
Weighting: The base can be filled with sandbags; do not use loose sand
Floor Mounting: Optional concealed mounting
Flammability Standards: Laminate surfaces pass CAL 117; the base is flame retardant and passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold (laminate tops not included)
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the base; 5-year warranty on the laminate top, against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
361 – 42” Round Plain Top: Gray Nebula laminate, black edge
361GT – 42” Round Game Top: Game top
363 – Medium Delta Top: Gray Nebula laminate, black edge
364 – Large Delta Top: Gray Nebula laminate, black edge
Installation and Options
Assembly: The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws; hardware bit size is T40
Floor Mounting: Optional concealed mounting with stud plates; concrete anchors and security Torx bolts are included; see Cortech instructions
Weighting: Add sandbags through the ballast door in the base; do not use loose sand. Ballast door bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Summit All Purpose Table suits dining and activity areas that want a durable table with a calm, residential look.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Activity and group rooms in residential treatment centers
Other secure settings that serve meals or hold group activities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Summit Series
The Cortech Summit Series is a line of molded seating and tables with a calm, residential look, made for behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. Most Summit seating comes in a standard molded finish or with a Veldura soft-touch exterior.
The Summit Series includes:
Chairs: Guest Chair (300 / 301), Accent Chair (310 / 311), and Lounge Chair (320 / 321)
Stools: Summit Stool (330 / 331)
Tables: Side Table (342 / 343), Mid-Range Table (353 / 354), and All Purpose Table (361 / 363 / 364)
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech Summit All Purpose Table - 361 / 363 / 364 at Anchortex
Meta description (159 characters): Shop the Cortech Summit All Purpose Table. A dining height table with a one-piece molded base and a 42” round or delta laminate top, with an optional game top.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Summit Series" is a new section for the Summit chairs, stools, and tables. It is the same on each Summit page.
H1: I wrote "All Purpose" without the hyphen, as Cortech does, and took out "Molded Base with Laminate Top" and "Models."
Variant names: your variants are 361S, 363S, and 364S, "with ballast door." The Cortech spec sheet lists 361, 361GT, 363, and 364, with no S models. Can you check the model numbers with Cortech? Your page does not have the 361GT game top as a variant.
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet gives the base (16 lbs) and tops (delta 45 lbs, round 56 lbs) separately, so the tables weigh about 72 lbs (round) and 61 lbs (delta). I used these totals for the worksheet.
Dimensions: the Cortech spec sheet gives one size for the delta top table (44”W×43”D×29”H) and does not give separate sizes for the medium and large delta tops.
Top color: the Cortech spec sheet lists the tops in Gray Nebula with a black edge.
GREENGUARD Gold: the Cortech spec sheet says "Greenguard Gold Certified *Laminate Tops not included," which I read as the certification covering the base only. I wrote "(laminate tops not included)." Please check the wording.
Concealed mounting: the Cortech concealed mounting instructions show the stud plates, concrete anchors, and security Torx bolts as included. They do not give a model number or say whether the mounting kit is sold separately.
Product images: the page has four images, including a Summit color chart. The Cortech product page has photos of the 42” round table in all 18 base colors. Would you like me to add them?
